important_limit: Archived final odds only, not T-10 snapshots. Exploratory research, not a frozen betting strategy.

definitions.market_probability: Within each ticket pool, normalize inverse final odds: q_j=(1/odds_j)/sum(1/odds).
definitions.D: log(sum normalized trifecta probability over the six orders of a 3-rider set / normalized trio probability of that set). Positive means trifecta market rates the set more strongly than trio market.
definitions.I: For each rider, log(trifecta-derived top3 inclusion marginal / trio-derived top3 inclusion marginal).
definitions.C: log(actual normalized trio probability / maximum-entropy trio probability fitted only to all riders' trio top3 inclusion marginals). Negative means the combination is underbought relative to its members' individual popularity.
definitions.H: log(actual normalized trifecta probability / maximum-entropy order probability fitted only to each rider's 1st/2nd/3rd-place marginals). Negative means the exact order is underbought relative to position popularity.
definitions.deciles: Rank metric within each race, 0=lowest contradiction value, 9=highest.
definitions.roi_pct_final_odds: Exploratory gross ROI if 100 yen were staked on every cell in the bucket at archived final odds. Not a T-10 executable backtest.
